Nelle fratture di gamba la radiografia d: In leg fractures the X-ray must include both joints (knee and ankle) in two views: a tibial fracture can be associated with a fibular fracture far from the focus (for example proximal). Describe site (proximal, middle, distal third), type (transverse, oblique, spiral, comminuted), displacement, angulation and shortening. Tibial fractures are at risk of compartment syndrome (disproportionate pain, pain on passive stretch): it must be sought clinically. In children undisplaced tibial shaft fractures are usually treated with a cast; the growth plates are checked as well.
